entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, connect me already. This is unbelievable.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return this helmet I bought. And I need it done now. Your company sent me the completely wrong thing.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To start, could you please provide your order number?

I don't have it in front of me! Look it up with my name, John Sterling. This is a complete waste of my time. The color is this hideous neon green, not the forest green I ordered. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.

I understand your frustration, Mr. Sterling. Let me just pull up your account. One moment... Okay, I see your recent order for the Aero-Dynamic helmet. I'm just checking the return eligibility for you.

There's nothing to check! It's wrong, I want my money back. If I don't get a return label in the next five minutes, I'm leaving a one-star review on every site I can find. Is that clear? Or do I need to speak to your manager?

That won't be necessary, sir. We definitely want you to be satisfied and confident in your gear's safety and appearance. I've reviewed your order date, and you are well within our 90-day return window.
So you're taking it back then? You're going to refund me?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at your convenience.
Oh. Okay. So the label's in my email now?

It should arrive within the next few minutes. Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
